name: Kanban basics
summary: Four columns and a work-in-progress limit: the simplest board that works.

lists.name: Backlog
lists.description: Everything you might do someday. Capture ideas here without committing to them; pull the next one into To do when you are ready to start.

lists.name: To do
lists.description: Committed work, in the order you will do it. Keep it short enough to finish; top card first.

lists.name: Doing
lists.description: Work in progress, limited to 3 cards. Finish something before you pull the next card. Agents: claim a card from To do, work it here, and move it on when it is done.

lists.name: Done
lists.description: Finished work. Leave cards here for a while as a record, then archive them.

cards.name: Move me to Doing
cards.description: Drag this card to **Doing**, or open it and use the list menu. The *Doing* column is limited to 3 cards, so finish work before starting more.

cards.name: Click a card to open details
cards.description: Cards open on a click: add a description, labels, tasks, a due date and comments there. Drag a card between columns to show progress.

cards.name: Add your own
cards.description: Type a title at the bottom of any column and press Enter to add a card; keep typing to add more. Delete these samples whenever you like.
